response.reason: The kernel is the standard Cephes atanf three-interval rational approximation (thresholds tan(3π/8)≈2.414 and 0.66, with the atanf coefficient set), correctly handling the upper branch via π/2 - atan(1/|x|) and the middle branch via π/4 + atan((m-1)/(m+1)); rounding-error analysis and Cephes's known ~2-ulp FP32 accuracy keep absolute error well under 1e-6 across the legal FP16 domain, and masking/absolute-value/sign handling cover subnormals, zeros, and ±65504.
